gabon.title: Flag of the Gabonese Republic

colors.note: Top band representing the country's forests and rich timber resources.
Middle band evoking the equator, which passes through Gabon, and the sun.
Bottom band standing for the Atlantic Ocean along the country's western coast.

desc:
- Three equal horizontal bands of green, yellow and blue with no emblem
- Adopted on 9 August 1960, days before full independence from France on 17 August
- Replaced an earlier tricolour that included a French flag in the canton and a narrower yellow stripe
trivia:
- The three equal horizontal bands mark the equator (yellow) running across central Gabon
- An earlier 1959 version had a narrow yellow stripe and the French tricolour in the canton
- The palette deliberately avoids the Pan-African red, choosing blue for the Atlantic instead
